questions.question:
In the following question below are given some statements followed by some conclusions based on those statements. Taking the given statements to be true even if they seem to be at variance from commonly known facts. Read all the conclusions and then decide which of the given conclusion logically follows the given statements.

**Statements:**

I. Some mobile are watch.

II. No watch is laptop.

**Conclusions:**

I. No laptop is mobile.

II. Some laptop are not watch.

options.text: Both conclusions I and II follows

questions.solution:
The least possible Venn diagram for the given statements is as shown below :

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/1ce3b86dec9ccb507da0e5e951736a01d66317e5db0f535a8167dc033763f533.png] 

Conclusions:

I. No laptop is mobile → Does not Follow (As some mobile are watch and no watch is laptop. As no direct relation is given between mobile and laptop, therefore it is false.)

II. Some laptop are not watch → Follow (As no watch is laptop. As direct relation is given between laptop and watch, therefore it is true.)

∴ Here, Only conclusion II follows.​

Hence, the correct answer is "Option 2"

questions.question:
Which of the following groups of letters when sequentially placed from left to right will complete the given series?

efgefge_ge_gef_ef_efg
questions.solution:
Given series: efgefge_ge_gef_ef_efg

Option 1) fege→ efgefge__f__ge__e__gef__g__ef__e__efg → (It doesn't follow any pattern)

Option 2) gefe → efgefge__g__ge__e__gef__f__ef__e__efg → (It doesn't follow any pattern)

Option 3) ffgg → efgefge__**f**__ge__**f**__gef__**g**__ef__**g**__efg → (It follows the pattern of: efg - efg - efg - efg - efg - efg - efg)

Option 4) efeg → efgefge__e__ge__f__gef__e__ef__g__efg → (It doesn't follow any pattern)

Hence, "Option 3" is the correct answer.

questions.question: Pointing towards a photo of a lady. Ram said. "She is the sister of my mother's daughter". How lady is related to Ram?
questions.solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/aecbe9ab6b7da7cca1ac2d356e84b8c992ce57c8b50affd73dfdd3dad30ceb2e.png] 

Given statement: Pointing towards a photo of a lady. Ram said. "She is the sister of my mother's daughter". 

As gender of Ram is not known, therefore there are two possible cases.

Case 1) Ram is the sibling of the Lady.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/0e8096e901c928c29eff61efd72d739728d89c7304c812d3632dce3dbc232c35.png] 

Case 2) If Ram is female, then Ram is the lady.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/06eaf81679457fbafcea36503e6c1401daa9381055d9a3e7caab5761daa74317.png] 

 

So, the lady can be either sister of Ram or Ram herself.

As out of all the options, 'Sister' is given, therefore case 2 will be eliminated.

Thus, the lady is Ram's sister.

Hence, the correct answer is "Option 3"
